Antwerp bureau: Gem Diamonds' Letšeng mine averaged $1,945 a carat in Q3, up 73% on a year earlier, as carats sold fell 21.6%.

Antwerpen: de Letšeng-mijn van Gem Diamonds haalde in Q3 gemiddeld $1.945 per karaat, 73% meer dan vorig jaar, terwijl de verkochte karaten 21,6% daalden.

Full story on caratcapital.org, link in bio.

Source: Gem Diamonds, Q3 2026 Trading Update (RNS), investegate.co.uk, 4 Nov 2026.
